mapper.insert: INSERT INTO kits (user_id, title, project_version, category, description, is_public) VALUES (#{userId}, #{title}, #{projectVersion}, #{category}, #{description}, #{isPublic})
INSERT INTO kit_items (kit_id, group_id, artifact_id, version) VALUES (#{kitId}, #{groupId}, #{artifactId}, #{version})
mapper.select: SELECT kit_id AS kitId, user_id AS userId, title, project_version AS projectVersion, category, description, is_public AS isPublic, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM kits WHERE kit_id = #{kitId}

SELECT kit_id AS kitId, user_id AS userId, title, project_version AS projectVersion, category, description, is_public AS isPublic, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM kits WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT item_id AS itemId, kit_id AS kitId, group_id AS groupId, artifact_id AS artifactId, version FROM kit_items WHERE kit_id = #{kitId} ORDER BY item_id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE kits SET title = #{title}, description = #{description}, is_public = #{isPublic}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE kit_id = #{kitId} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM kits WHERE kit_id = #{kitId} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT k.kit_id AS kitId, k.user_id AS userId, u.nickname AS ownerName, k.title, k.project_version AS projectVersion, k.created_at AS createdAt FROM kits k JOIN kit_user u ON k.user_id = u.user_id ORDER BY k.created_at DESC
